page.layout: One column of running text, with one marginal note at the left, beside the line "res uendita". Page number at the head. Running head at the top of the page.

main_text.l: D.de trib.act. Lex est: Res le-
domus mea est. D. Imò mea.
mihi abs te, atque tradita est:
F. At nec precium soluisti, nec
ndetur, non esse d.L. quod uen-

page.notes: The left marginal mark beside "res uendita" appears to be a Hebrew or other non-Latin note, but it is too faint and damaged to read; it is marked as illegible. The running head is decorative and only partly legible. "sed" is printed as "fed" with long s, and "est" as "eft"; both are normalised. "§" in "5. §." is uncertain. The reading "uendidi" for "uēdidi" and "precium" for "preciū" is uncertain, and the first line may be taken from the previous page.
